verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a payments platform with SDKs, a dashboard, and EBANX.js, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no opt-out control. The only related item describes EBANX.js performing device fingerprinting, which is tracking rather than a way to disable it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
